title: Change Order Terms and Owner Selection Allowances, Reconstruction Agreements
content:
Estimating sets these change order terms for each Reconstruction agreement.

## Change order terms

| Agreement | Markup | Owner upgrade deposit | Validity days | Proposals awaiting signature at a time | Change order minimum | Material escalation threshold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | 20% | 100% | 10 | 2 | $75.00 | 10% |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | 20% | 50% | 14 | 3 | $150.00 | 10% |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | 20% | 50% | 14 | 5 | $250.00 | 7% |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | 20% | 50% | 21 | 8 | $350.00 | 5% |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | 15% | 50% | 14 | 4 | $150.00 | 10% |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | 15% | 50% | 30 | 10 | $500.00 | 5% |

- **Markup**: the overhead and profit markup added to change order line pricing, as a percentage.
- **Owner upgrade deposit**: the share of an owner upgrade change order that must be paid before the upgrade is ordered.
- **Validity days**: calendar days a change order proposal remains open for signature before it is voided.
- **Proposals awaiting signature at a time**: the number of change orders that may await signature on one contract at a time.
- **Change order minimum**: the smallest additive change order written; smaller additions are absorbed, in US dollars.
- **Material escalation threshold**: the documented supplier price increase on a contract material above which the excess may be billed as a change order, as a percentage.

## Owner selection allowances

An allowance is the owner's selection allowance for a material; a selection above it is an owner upgrade.

| Agreement | Flooring material, per square foot | Cabinet material, per linear foot | Plumbing or lighting fixture, each |
|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | $3.25 | $185.00 | $145.00 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | $3.25 | $185.00 | $145.00 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | $3.75 | $225.00 | $185.00 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | $4.50 | $275.00 | $225.00 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | $2.85 | $165.00 | $125.00 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | $4.25 | $245.00 | $195.00 |

## Points of reading

- The Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs is the only agreement on which the whole of an owner upgrade (100%) is due before the upgrade is ordered.
- The markup is 15% on the Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement and the Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement and 20% on the others.
